news.title: Mobile Wallet Registrations Climb in UK, Challenging High Street Banks
news.body: New data shows that 63% of UK consumers are registered with at least one mobile wallet provider, a trend that is reducing card usage at major banks like Barclays and Lloyds. These banks face declining transaction volumes and customer engagement unless they prioritize wallet integration and digital product enhancements to keep pace with shifting consumer preferences.

news.title: Visa and Mastercard Join Agentic Payments Alliance to Shape AI Commerce Standards
news.body: Visa, Mastercard, and other payments leaders have joined the Agentic Payments Alliance to guide the development of AI-driven commerce. Their involvement allows them to influence technical standards and regulatory frameworks, while payment processors and fintechs outside the alliance could face integration barriers as protocols are established.

news.title: SEC Proposes New Crypto Offering Rules, Focusing on Platform Registration and Disclosure
news.body: The SEC has proposed rules requiring crypto platforms to register and provide detailed disclosures, aiming to clarify digital asset investment frameworks. Crypto firms should expect stricter compliance checks, enhanced reporting obligations, and a clearer path to institutional market participation, while unregistered platforms risk being barred from regulated activities.

news.title: Citi to Launch Bitcoin Custody, Competing on Technology and Security
news.body: Citi will introduce bitcoin custody services via its Custody+ platform, offering real-time asset servicing and AI-powered analytics. This move targets institutional clients seeking secure, regulated digital asset storage, and challenges established crypto custodians to match Citi’s technology and compliance standards.

news.title: Revolut Founder Unlocks $250 Million Loan Capacity as Valuation Climbs
news.body: Revolut founder Nik Storonsky has secured the ability to borrow up to $250 million against his equity stake, reflecting the fintech’s rising valuation. This capital flexibility could fund expansion or strategic investments, prompting rivals to accelerate their own product launches or M&A activity.
